scope: Source-linked native GPIO plus actual nrfx init/in-init/enable/disable/uninit execute in Unicorn with populated tables; initialized state, low-power allocation and repeated-open idempotence checked
limitations: Newlib memory/string runtime is a binary test dependency.
Peripheral registers are emulated, without asynchronous interrupts or electrical line models.
Shared-pin duplicate close coherence is not tested.
Stock differential covers statuses, ordered peripheral/core writes and relocated nrfx control state; physical hardware remains unproven.
